text: The sea wasn't always like this.
Too many things changed after the infection. Fishwalkers have appeared near the docks.
I figured as much. 'Tis safer 'round here now. Here, take this.
I heard some noises coming from the sunken ship. Can ya check it for me?
Using diving equipment enhances your super attack. Each piece you find increases the number of crosses and the speed of the aiming game. Find all three!
